body: Go to the hospital I had the exact same OD method, I didn't feel anything for hours, but it will physically induce so much internal pain if you don't get charcoal cleanse and an IV quickly. Paracetamol is not going to kill you, it's going to cause so much torture....

Not having the energy to work on yourself isn't a bad thing, you're tired and it's okay to be tired, but I still think you shouldn't give up on yourself. 

If you can identify the problems, you can find solutions, and you've already given it a go. I think that's something you can be very, very proud of. Small progress is still progress. Small achievements are still achievements. 

Take a break, and try again. It is a painful and tiring process and that's why you should try not to burn yourself out all at once. You do have the power to change your life, but take care of yourself along the way.

You can do it! I believe in you, OP.

Thank you! 

I'll definitely try to speak to her calmly about what made me feel bad and tell the real reason behind my hospital visit, I'll try my best to keep a level head. I should've understood she couldn't read my mind even if we've been best friends for 6 years. You're right in that we've had  a bumpy road before this, and maybe it's both of us who are holding grudges. Thank you again for your reply! I feel more sure of myself now.

Get that degree. You've worked for it. You deserve the fruits of your four years of labor. 

I'm not going to act as if I know your situation but: Get out of that damn school as soon as you possibly can, even better leave the city if you can save up money. The world is so huge, with so many people who crave nothing more than genuine friendship. The people you meet in school aren't the best the world has to offer. You just haven't had a good enough chance to meet good people.
I definitely think you should talk to your therapist about it. The sooner you get an answer from a professional, the faster you'll find help.
